verdict.rationale: The firm's own IP pages describe IP litigation work. The patents page names a venue, citing JUVE that it can "handle multiple complex UPC cases at the same time"; the IP page quotes Chambers that its team "can handle all types of IP litigation"; and the trade marks page references "complex disputes." Missing for 10: named case outcomes or judgments, courts or venues beyond the UPC, any trade-secret litigation evidence, and detail beyond accolade quotes.
